title: HB-PVI: A Hierarchical Bayesian Personalization and Value-of-Information Framework for Complex Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2609.05582v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalization can improve activity-recognition performance, but participant-specific gains are heterogeneous, and every additional calibration label has an acquisition cost. This study presents HB-PVI, a hierarchical Bayesian personalization and value-of-information framework jointly modeling participant heterogeneity, the benefit and harm of four personalization mechanisms, and the economic value of an additional label, for the 47-participant MUSIC-CAR complex-activity cohort. A leakage-safe, leave-one-participant-out evaluation combines a sequential-Monte-Carlo participant-effect updater with a Student-$t$ hierarchical gain model and a one-step expected-value-of-sample-information (EVSI) stopping rule. Adapter personalization produced small positive mean F1 gains, growing from 0.00099 at one label to 0.00198 at ten, while adapter-plus-head and prototype-residual personalization were negative on average. translated_title: HB-PVI：一种用于复杂活动识别的层次贝叶斯个性化与信息价值框架
translated_abstract: 个性化可以提升活动识别性能，但参与者特定的收益是异质的，且每增加一个校准标签都有获取成本。本研究提出了HB-PVI，一个层次贝叶斯个性化与信息价值框架，针对47名参与者的MUSIC-CAR复杂活动队列，联合建模参与者异质性、四种个性化机制的收益与损害，以及额外标签的经济价值。一种无泄漏的留一参与者评估方法将序贯蒙特卡洛参与者效应更新器、学生t分布层次增益模型与一步样本信息期望值（EVSI）停止规则相结合。适配器个性化产生了小幅的正平均F1增益，从一个标签时的0.00099增长到十个标签时的0.00198，而适配器加头部以及原型残差个性化平均为负。在主要的实际应用……
tldr: 提出HB-PVI框架，通过层次贝叶斯模型与EVSI停止规则，联合量化复杂活动识别中参与者异质性、四种个性化机制的收益以及校准标签的经济价值。
en_tdlr: HB-PVI is a hierarchical Bayesian framework that jointly models participant heterogeneity, the benefits and harms of personalization mechanisms, and the economic value of additional calibration labels using a sequential Monte Carlo updater and an EVSI stopping rule for complex activity recognition.
